page.notes: Two marginal notes are reference marks: the left "f" and "t" notes, and the in-text marks {f} and {t}, are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The word "legendæ" after "legen-" is doubtful. The "Ho-/noratum" hyphenation and the accent on "norátum" and "imperásse" are doubtful. The line "fa-" / "crifi-" at the foot: the first syllable is read as "sa-" (long s), so the word is probably "sacrificandi"; it is marked as doubtful. "Cap.5" is kept as part of the running head. The line "quibusfingulis" is printed without a space and is left as printed.
